text:
samantha: FYI EU midnight change window tonight 00:00-02:00 UTC. Need someone to pin v3.7.4 (model-serving) and own smoke checks. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/3.7.4. Also quick rollback plan required.

matt: I can take pin and canary warmup. Anyone owning smoke?

ria: I'll do smoke tests + perf baseline. Running the curated prompt set.

alex: @ops-oncall pls confirm fallback capacity & routing policy for this window.

ops-oncall: Confirmed. Reserved pool + fallback to small-quantized variant. SLA targets intact. I'll monitor alerts.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Request received: pin request by matt for model:v3.7.4 -> queued.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Pin applied to prod-routing at commit a1b2c3. Canary started (10% traffic) — URL: https://canary.prod.redwood/3.7.4

matt: Canary running. Initial 5-min smoke okay. CPU spike ~15% for batcher, watching.

ria: Perf baseline compared: p50 latency +12ms, token cost -1.2%. No semantic regressions on smoke set.

alex: Release note snippet: 'Improved KV cache packing and quantization fallback; fixes for streaming reconnects' — will push to docs when stable.

matt: Rollback plan pinned: if error-rate > 1.5% or latency p95 > 1.3x baseline for 10m -> roll back to v3.7.3. Rollback command:
```bash
/deploy rollback --to v3.7.3 --scope prod --reason "canary fail"
```

ria: Added quick eval script to infra-runner: `infra-run eval smoke --model v3.7.4`

ops-oncall: I've set an alert mute schedule for noise reduction, will notify if thresholds cross.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary at 10% healthy for 12m. Promoting to 50%.

matt: Promoted to 50%. Can somebody start staggered traffic ramp schedule? 50->100 over 30m.

ria: Starting stagger: 50 -> 75 after 10m, then 100 after 20m if stable.

alex: Doc update pushed: release notes + changelog. Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/releases/3.7.4

matt: Good. Leaving handoff: @ops-oncall will watch final ramp. @ops-oncall give thumbs when you think it's safe to lock the quiet window.

ops-oncall: Thumbs up :thumbsup: Locking quiet window 00:10 UTC start. All smoke checks green. I'll keep monitoring for 60m.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promotion complete: v3.7.4 is live at 100% traffic. Notifying #incidents and monitoring channels.

samantha: Thanks team. Postmortem-free unless alerts spike. Will draft release summary tomorrow.
